figurative_meaning_en: Habit of stealing or thieving tendency
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে হাত লম্বা লোক, কখনো তার কাছে মূল্যবান জিনিস রাখো না।
গ্রামের এই লোকটির হাত লম্বা বলে সবাই সতর্ক থাকে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has long hands, so never leave valuables with him.
Everyone in the village stays cautious because that man has a thieving tendency.
history: This idiom originates from the observation that poverty drives people to steal, metaphorically extending their 'reach' like long hands to grab what they lack.
note: The idiom reflects socio-economic realities in Bengali society, emphasizing the link between deprivation and petty crime.
